mentions.name: super-release
mentions.description: An open-source alternative to semantic-release written in Rust with mono-repo support, built to make shipping packages in larger JavaScript/TypeScript mono-repos easier.
mentions.audience: Make shipping packages in larger JavaScript/TypeScript mono-repos easier.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://github.com/BowlingX/super-release, an alternative written in rust for semantic-release and mono-repo support. I build it mainly to make shipping packages in larger JavaScript/Typescript mono-repos easier.
mentions.author: bowlingx
